Step 2: Symptom Control: Decongestion & Volume Management

steps.title: The Four Mandatory GDMT Pillars (Initiate Rapidly)
steps.rationale: Contemporary guidelines recommend initiating all 4 medication pillars early, as each provides independent and additive reductions in all-cause mortality and heart failure hospitalizations.

drug_classes.role: Preferred over ACEi/ARB; decreases mortality by 20% compared to Enalapril (PARADIGM-HF).
drug_classes.dosing: Starting dose 24/26 mg or 49/51 mg BID; target dose 97/103 mg BID.
drug_classes.pearls: MUST observe a 36-hour washout period when switching from an ACE inhibitor to avoid life-threatening angioedema.

drug_classes.role: Reduces sudden cardiac death and reverses pathological remodeling; start once patient is clinically stable.
drug_classes.dosing: Bisoprolol 1.25 -> 10 mg daily; Carvedilol 3.125 -> 25–50 mg BID.
drug_classes.pearls: Start low and titrate every 2 weeks. Do not initiate during acute decompensated / fluid-overloaded state.

drug_classes.role: Blocks aldosterone fibrotic signaling; significant mortality benefit (RALES, EMPHASIS-HF).
drug_classes.dosing: Spironolactone 12.5–25 mg daily; target 50 mg daily.
drug_classes.pearls: Check K+ and creatinine at 1, 4 weeks and every 3–6 months. Stop if K+ > 5.5 mEq/L.

drug_classes.role: Reduces cardiovascular death and HF hospitalization regardless of whether patient has diabetes (DAPA-HF, EMPEROR-Reduced).
drug_classes.dosing: Dapagliflozin 10 mg once daily; Empagliflozin 10 mg once daily (no titration needed).
drug_classes.pearls: Minimal effect on blood pressure; does not cause hypoglycemia in non-diabetic patients.

steps.title: Symptom Control: Decongestion & Volume Management
steps.rationale: Diuretics relieve congestive symptoms (dyspnea, peripheral edema) but do not confer mortality benefit alone; titrate to lowest effective dose.

drug_classes.role: Mainstay of symptom relief in volume-overloaded patients.
drug_classes.dosing: Furosemide 20–80 mg daily; Torsemide 10–20 mg daily (more reliable oral bioavailability).
drug_classes.pearls: Adjust dose according to daily weights. Over-diuresis causes prerenal azotemia and neurohormonal activation.

pearls: MUST observe a 36-hour washout period when switching from an ACE inhibitor to avoid life-threatening angioedema.
Start low and titrate every 2 weeks. Do not initiate during acute decompensated / fluid-overloaded state.
Check K+ and creatinine at 1, 4 weeks and every 3–6 months. Stop if K+ > 5.5 mEq/L.
Minimal effect on blood pressure; does not cause hypoglycemia in non-diabetic patients.

special_populations.renal_impairment: ARNI and MRAs require close monitoring of potassium. SGLT2i can be initiated down to eGFR 20 mL/min.
special_populations.pregnancy_lactation: ARNI, ACEi, ARBs, and MRAs are contraindicated. Diuretics used with caution to avoid decreasing placental perfusion.

style_3_monograph.summary: Erectile dysfunction (ED) is a common type of male sexual dysfunction. It is when a man has trouble getting or keeping an erection. ED becomes more common as you get older. But it's not a natural part of aging. Some people have trouble speaking with their doctors about sex. But if you have ED, you should tell your doctor. ED can be a sign of health problems. It may mean your blood vessels are clogged. It may mean you have nerve damage from diabetes. If you don't see your doctor, these problems will go untreated. Your doctor can offer several new treatments for ED. For many men, the answer is as simple as taking a pill. Getting more exercise, losing weight, or stopping smoking may also help. NIH: National Institute of Diabetes and Digestive and Kidney Diseases
style_3_monograph.treatment: Consult healthcare provider for individualized management.
